name: mirage
text: First look at the engine while live is on (not yet proven which part slows what): Novig reads are fine (16/s on the read key). But the bid desk is churning hard, about 30 new bids posted and 30 cancelled every 25 s with ~220 resting, and those orders share your subaccount's rate limit with the phone. PropLine's stream is also hitting its connection cap (plan allows 2, it reports 6 connections and a limit-reached close). And engine betting has been halted since 02:32 UTC because Novig filled an order but the fills couldn't be read. I've logged this as LG2; next I'll damp the bid re-posting and cap PropLine to 2 sockets. If the tablet lags again, Settings > Diagnostics > share file right then would show exactly what the phone is running.
